isotonic_data_support.rule: run only when each chronological calibration fold has at least 1,000 rows and at least 100 examples per class
isotonic_data_support.limitation: Rows across adjacent dates are correlated, so nominal fold counts overstate independent calibration information.

final_test_usage: The final test set was not used for fit, calibration, method comparison, or selection; only the saved production model was scored after validation analyses completed.
